government-intervention-tax.alt: A $2 per-unit tax on ferry rides shifts supply up by $2: 40 rides are traded instead of 50, buyers pay $6 and sellers keep $4, tax revenue is $80 and the deadweight loss triangle between 40 and 50 rides is $10.

government-intervention-controls.alt: Left: a $3 price ceiling below the $5 equilibrium leaves a shortage of 40 ferry rides and only 30 traded. Right: a $7 price floor above it leaves a surplus of 40 and only 30 traded. Both create a deadweight loss triangle from 30 to 50 rides.
